about_the_game:
Welcome to Neverless Academy – a totally normal, definitely safe, absolutely not-haunted boarding school.

Here, students split into “houses,” but instead of studying, they:

  • Electrocute each other for “science,”

  • Freeze doors shut instead of using keys,

  • And fence with actual blades during recess, because “safety first” is just a suggestion.

And yes, there’s a monster in the halls. Will it catch you? Absolutely. Probably while you’re busy scrolling your phone or looking at the wallpaper.

The goal? Survive classes you never enrolled in, avoid being monster food, and maybe graduate. (Spoiler: you won’t.)

Features

  • “The Walking Foot” – a normal human foot. Just… walking. Don’t ask.

  • Magical abilities: zap, freeze, and generally ruin someone’s day.

  • NPCs with actual routines (they spar, study, and ignore you just like your real classmates).

  • Cloudy gothic vibes™ (sunlight costs extra DLC).

  • Graphics presets from “Potato” to “Nuclear Reactor.”

P.S. – This is definitely not based on any streaming giant’s spooky school show. We checked with our lawyer. He cried.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 3 3300X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti / AMD RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 / RTX 2060 / AMD RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: Neverless Academy is a multiplayer-ish, singleplayer-ish, horror-ish, school-ish, life-choice-ish game. Basically, you wander a cursed academy while NPCs pretend to have lives and a monster ruins yours.
